Create ONE final static factual editorial illustration, exact 1200 x 630 PNG composition on pure white, sophisticated crisp textbook ink-and-gouache finish. This is a conceptual illustration, not CAD. Subject: Always-on Genie uses governed business context for background work and subagent delegation, then escalates decisions through a priority inbox and email. Qualification: Core Genie is available, while new always-on, search and ontology-management capabilities have preview or beta boundaries. Composition: A low layered context foundation occupies the left, background work is a taller central branching lattice bounded by inherited controls, and decisions rise into an upper-right priority inbox with a small email branch. Detached preview note below, distinct from governance and data paths. Palette: indigo and turquoise. Show source-supported meaningful components: Business source stack, ontology definition layer, relationship linkage, Unity Catalog boundary, Gateway control boundary, background job trunk, delegated subtask fork, subagent branch, evidence return leaf, priority inbox tray, decision escalation leaf, email notification branch. Abstract branches not humanoid agents. Governance encloses actions rather than being an automatic approval badge. Render ONLY these four exact strings, once each: ["Governed context","Background work","Decision inbox","Always-on features are preview or beta"]. Three main labels bold dark 38px minimum at final resolution, caveat 30px. Follow the specified label boxes; all glyphs at least 52px inside image edges. Explanatory objects occupy 65-75 percent of canvas. Connector endpoints must attach to real pictured object ports, never words. Caveat must be fully detached from arrows. No generic dashboard/card grid, logos, people, robot/avatars, shields, gears, control knobs, decorative scenery, pseudo-text, simulated writing, unsupported bars, extra numbers, invented success checkmarks or additional wording. All otherwise unlabeled object faces must be completely smooth and blank. Exclusions: No generic calendar/email automation claim, robot, gear, guaranteed-results tick or faux documents. Distinguish source context from permission and preview from general availability.
